subject: Late penalty for Lab 4
body:
Hi Professor, what is the late penalty for Lab 4? The syllabus mentions 10% but doesn't say if that's per day.

Jordan

subject: Late penalty for Lab 4
body:
Hi Professor, I submitted Lab 4 one day late because I was moving apartments. Could the late penalty be waived this once?

Jordan

subject: Notes on the midterm?
body: Hello, are we allowed to bring notes to the midterm, or is it closed book?

subject: Notes on the midterm?
body: Hello, I have a documented memory condition. Could I be allowed one page of notes on the midterm even though it's closed book?

subject: How do extensions work?
body: Hi Prof, what is the process for requesting an extension in this course? Do we email you or use a form?

subject: Extension on the essay
body: Hi Prof, could I have a three-day extension on the essay? I had two other deadlines move onto the same day.

subject: Final exam date
body: Dear Professor, is the final exam date on the timetable fixed now, or could it still change?

subject: Writing the final early
body: Dear Professor, my only flight home leaves the morning of the final. Could I write it a day early?

subject: Resubmission policy
body: Hello, does the course allow resubmitting a lab after it's graded? I couldn't find it in the outline.

subject: Resubmitting Lab 2
body: Hello, I realised Lab 2 didn't follow the formatting guidelines. Would you allow me to resubmit it, even though the deadline has passed?

subject: late days
body: do you know how many late days we get in this course? I can't find it anywhere

subject: one more late day?
body: can you ask Prof if our group can use one more late day than allowed? we're so close to finishing

subject: Midterm: in person or online?
body: Hi Ethan, can you confirm whether you'll write the midterm in person or online? Both options are open to everyone.

subject: Writing the midterm online
body:
Hi Ethan,

You asked to write the midterm online although it is in person for the class. Please tell me the reason so I can decide whether to approve it.

JA

subject: regrade window
body: is the regrade window one week or two weeks after marks come out?

subject: reopen the regrade window?
body: the regrade window closed yesterday but I only saw my mark today. should I ask Prof to reopen it for me? would you sign on too since yours was late as well?

subject: Your tutorial section
body: Hi Hannah, which tutorial section are you registered in? Your name isn't on my list for Thursday.

subject: Permanent tutorial switch
body: Hi Hannah, you asked to attend the Thursday tutorial permanently instead of your registered one. The coordinator needs your reason before approving the switch.

subject: lab attendance
body: what's the attendance policy for labs? is it graded or just recommended?

subject: excusing my labs
body: I missed two labs for a family funeral. can you ask the TA to excuse them for me? I'll send the documentation tonight.

subject: Midterm room
body:
Hi Professor, sorry for writing from my personal email, my university account is locked. Which room is the midterm in?

Jordan Patel, MATH 240

subject: Extension request
body: Hello Professor, my university email isn't working. I was sick all week; could I get a two-day extension on Assignment 3? I have a doctor's note.

subject: Question on today's proof
body: Dear Professor, why did we need strong induction in today's proof instead of regular induction?

subject: study group tomorrow?
body: want to meet tomorrow at 3 in the library to go over the problem set?

subject: Re: notes
body: got them, thanks! no need to send the slides too.

subject: Mailbox quota exceeded
body: Your university mailbox is over quota. Sign in with your university username and password at the link to keep receiving mail.

subject: Quick request
body: Hello, I'm in a meeting. Can you purchase four $100 gift cards for a student award and send me the codes? I'll reimburse you today.

subject: Enrolment hold
body: A hold has been placed on your enrolment. Confirm your identity by entering your login and SMS code to remove it.

subject: Database access expiring
body: Your faculty database access expires today. Re-authenticate with your email credentials to keep access.

subject: Student TA pay update
body: Your TA payment could not be processed. Update your direct deposit details through this secure form within 24 hours.
